state.contract:
# Four-character hexadecimal conversion

Provide two pure operations between unsigned 16-bit integers and text.

Formatting accepts every integer from 0 through 65,535 and returns exactly four
ASCII characters. Characters are lowercase hexadecimal digits, with leading
zeroes retained. Their left-to-right place values are 4,096, 256, 16 and 1.

Parsing accepts a finite text value. It succeeds exactly when the text has four
characters and every character belongs to 0–9 or a–f. Success returns the integer
represented by those place values. All other text returns one invalid-input
result. Uppercase letters, signs, spaces, separators, prefixes and Unicode
lookalikes are rejected. The parser does not trim or normalize its input.

Parsing a formatted integer must recover that integer. Formatting a successfully
parsed text must reproduce that text exactly. Both operations leave their inputs
unchanged and produce the same result on every call. There is no locale,
streaming state, configurable base, alternative encoding, network format or
additional diagnostic requirement. Internal arithmetic must preserve the stated
range and reject invalid text without overflow or partial success.

criteria: Routine: The stated obligation is direct bookkeeping, conversion or a settled local operation. Clear exact execution captures its conceptual content; a deep reframing would add little to this task.
Local structure: A fitting representation or small composition can absorb local cases and expose useful invariants, but the stated task offers limited room for a profound new organizing idea.

Generative structure: Several substantive relationships can be unified into a compact mechanism with consequences inside the stated task. A strong abstraction is warranted, but the contract does not establish a deep reframing or wider non-obvious connection as an appropriate expectation.

Reframing opportunity: The stated constraints and relationships provide substantial, identifiable room for a surprising unifying principle that changes understanding of the problem and exposes non-obvious connections. A Galaxy-brain composition is a relevant, proportionate target.

Foundational opportunity: The task centrally joins distinct models, representations or domains whose common structure could yield a powerful explanatory principle with traceable consequences beyond the immediate case. Deep reframing is a defining opportunity of the requested work.
